findings.issue: `derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_span` (and its private helper `derivationVanishingIdeal`, line 134) assume `[HopfAlgebra R H]` from the section variable at line 54, but the statement mentions no Hopf ideal and the proof uses only the counit and the Leibniz rule — the antipode is never used. The lemma is a bialgebra fact stated at Hopf level, so it is unavailable for the bialgebra-level tangent API the rest of the theory is built on.

summary: The determinant/trace computation and the SL identification sit at the right level, but the PR bolts a second, coefficient-linear bundling of the closed-subgroup differential onto the existing R-Lie-hom bundling instead of stating that differential once over B, and the new span lemma carries an unused `HopfAlgebra` hypothesis.
